"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Picture, Road, Scene, Sky

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (60, 130, 230)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
road = scene.add("road", Road("gray"), size=(640, 80), at=(0, 400), layer="scenery")
blue_monster = scene.add("blue_monster", Picture("assets/blue_monster.png"),
                         size=(100, 96), at=(300, 300), layer="things")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False
        # Open Nest: clicking blue monster -- or Space with the player over it -- hits it: a point, and it goes round again.
        if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN or (event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_SPACE):
            aim = event.pos if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN else player.center
            for blue_monster in scene.get("blue_monster"):
                if blue_monster.drawn_rect().collidepoint(aim):
                    score += 1
                    blue_monster.respawn()
                    break

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Building, Coin, Picture, Road, Scene, Sky

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (125, 195, 245)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
road = scene.add("road", Road("gray"), size=(640, 80), at=(0, 400), layer="scenery")
wall = scene.add("wall", Building("brown"),
                 size=(150, 150), at=(500, 300), on="road", layer="things")
blue_monster = scene.add("blue_monster", Picture("assets/blue_monster.png"),
                         size=(100, 96), at=(400, 300), on="wall", layer="things")
coin = scene.add("coin", Coin("gold"), size=(30, 30), at=(450, 350), layer="things")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching blue_monster scores a point.
    for touched in scene.touched(player, "blue_monster"):
        score += 1
        touched.respawn()
    # Open Nest: touching wall sends the player back to the start.
    if scene.touched(player, "wall"):
        player.topleft = (WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2)
    # Open Nest: touching coin scores a point.
    for coin in scene.touched(player, "coin"):
        score += 1
        coin.respawn()
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
